0.2.0.en: Big update. 40 new Flow cards: tonneau, sunroof, seat cooling, boombox, guest and low power modes, software updates, charging, sleep/wake, driving and arriving or leaving home. Completed-drive reports with the car's driver profile, whether a lock or unlock came from Homey or outside it, optional Timeline posts, new icons and images. Flow actions now reliably send commands, plus many fixes.
